rule.name: lib-anchored-placeholder-v1
rule.statement: Every timing number is a placeholder, never a memory measurement. Each corner's numbers derive from one committed anchor delay (BUFx4_ASAP7_75t_R cell_rise at table position index_1[3]/index_2[3] of the pinned asap7sc7p5t_28 RVT decks) times the fixed multipliers below: clk->q x10 (a placeholder read path of decode + sense + mux + out-drive, ten buffer stages at the library's own speed scale), setup x1, hold x0.2, min_pulse_width x2, max_transition x4, output transition x3. minimum_period = clk->q + setup. Pin capacitances and the output max_capacitance are corner-invariant placeholders. The cell area is not an independent input: the generator reads the committed LEF abstract's SIZE (layout/macros/npu_sram_bank.lef) and emits its width x height product, corner-invariant like the pin capacitances, so the Liberty area cannot drift from the LEF footprint. The anchors differ per corner, so the macro tracks the standard-cell library it is timed beside. This mirrors by reference what the origin's analytical macro corners are (sky130-npu#159: algebraic factors on a baseline, not a re-characterisation).

anchor.index_1_note: input transition, 40 ps at position 3 (library time_unit is 1ps)
anchor.index_2_note: output load, 23.04 fF at position 3 (library capacitive_load_unit is 1ff)
